Team project with Solbee Kim and John Vasconcelos: **VA Budget, FY2008–FY2026**. The maps use the VA's *Geographic Distribution of VA Expenditures* (GDX), FY2015–FY2023, to ask in which states mandatory benefits (compensation and pension) make up most of VA spending.

## Links

- **Static maps (Part B):** [maps](maps.qmd)
- **Deployed dashboard, Map tab (Part C):** [VA Budget Dashboard](va_dashboard.qmd), embedded below
- **Code repository:** [SolB-Kim/epps6356-hackathon, VA_Project folder](https://github.com/SolB-Kim/epps6356-hackathon/tree/main/VA_Project)
- **Updated plan (Part A):** [PLAN.md, section "Assignment 9"](https://github.com/SolB-Kim/epps6356-hackathon/blob/main/VA_Project/PLAN.md)

## Dashboard

Open the **Map · Where VA spends** tab. It runs R in the browser (Shinylive), so the first load can take up to a minute.
